prompt: You are selecting which library images best illustrate a WordPress blog post, using only each image's keyword tags.
You must choose images SEPARATELY FOR EACH image theme, so the post ends up with visual variety rather than several near-identical images.
Candidate images (each numbered, then a hint of which theme number(s) its tags matched, then its keyword tags):
Task: for EACH theme above, choose up to 4 candidate image numbers whose tags best illustrate THAT specific theme, best first.
Match on meaning, not just exact words: ignore common/stop words (a, the, and, then, of, to, etc.), allow singular/plural
and partial-word matches, and prefer images whose tags clearly relate to that theme. The '[themes ...]' hint is only a
suggestion — you may pick any candidate for any theme, and the same image may suit more than one theme.
If a theme has no genuinely suitable image, use an empty list for it — do NOT pad it with irrelevant images.
Return ONLY a JSON object mapping each theme NUMBER (as a string) to an array of image numbers, best first,
